headline: HuyenBao v11.13 — ecosystem development roadmap added to repo + in-app pointer
summary: A full ecosystem development roadmap (ECOSYSTEM.md) is now committed to the repo, describing the connected family of apps around HuyenBao: the life-simulation hub (this game), future simulation games (racing, farming, livestock, manufacturing, armed-base building), the Elliot crypto-trading app (earn real money), and the Huyền Học AI app (mysticism research applied to daily life — app.huyenbao.com). The roadmap covers vision, the 8 components with status, connection principles (shared identity, shared local LLM/Ollama, cross-game assets), a 5-phase timeline, the shared tech stack, and the ecosystem-wide disclaimer. A new 'Ecosystem roadmap' fold in the Home tab lists all 8 components (EN/VI/ZH) and links to the GitHub document.
features: New ECOSYSTEM.md in repo root: vision, 8-component table (HuyenBao hub + racing + farming + livestock + manufacturing + armed base + Elliot + Huyền Học AI) with status, connection principles (shared identity, shared Ollama LLM, cross-game assets/fame), 5-phase roadmap (hub+huyền học → Elliot → sim games → manufacturing+arsenal → ecosystem glue), shared tech stack, dev run instructions, ecosystem-wide disclaimer
New 'Ecosystem roadmap' fold in Home tab (after the How-to-play guide): blurb + 8 component one-liners + link to GitHub ECOSYSTEM.md (EN/VI/ZH via eco.* i18n keys)
Version bumped to v11.13 on homepage header + version.json
